items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lenny used to be, he was very much of a liberal in those days... Lenny was sort of a half baked clarinet player himself

ctx.x: Yeah. They were always very funny, Lenny used to be, he was very much of a liberal in those days, he was, for all I know he still might be a little bit even though he’s been into conservative politics, he always sort of laughed at the whole thing.
He claimed he was never a registered Republican right?
